mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं)
A servant.
E.
किं what or something, and कर who does.

f. (-णिः or -णी)
1 A girdle of small bells, or any tinkling ornament.
2 An acid sort of grape.
E.
किं some, and किण an imitative sound, affix क, with इन् or ङीष् fem. affix; also with कन् added किङ्किणीका.
